title: Evidence replay controls
responsibility: Provides playback, frame, scene, speed and fullscreen controls for an evidence replay.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.playing
inputs.description: Required current playback state, choosing the play or pause presentation.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.index
inputs.description: Required current frame index, used for timeline position and previous/next availability.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.count
inputs.description: Required frame count. The timeline spans zero through count minus one, bounded at zero, and is disabled below two frames.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.elapsed
inputs.description: Required elapsed playback time, formatted in seconds.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.total
inputs.description: Required total playback time, formatted in seconds.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.title
inputs.description: Required replay title displayed in the controls.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.scene
inputs.description: Required selected scene number or null. Null leaves the scene selector on its placeholder.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.scenes
inputs.description: Required scene choices. An empty array hides the scene selector.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.fullscreen
inputs.description: Required current fullscreen state, selecting the appropriate toggle presentation.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.speed
inputs.description: Optional bindable playback multiplier, defaulting to 1, chosen from the component’s supported speed options.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.onseek
inputs.description: Required callback receiving a requested frame index from the slider, previous/next controls or latest-frame action.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.onscene
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the selected scene number.

outputs.name: ReplayControls
outputs.description: Playback toolbar, frame timeline, elapsed/total time, speed and optional scene selection. It requests actions from the host and does not run its own playback timer.
